title: Win on AI assistants and own channels as memory costs squeeze PCs
summary: Amazon added 100+ Alexa for Shopping functions, merchant registration and text shopping; Walmart upgraded Sparky; Visa found AI models fail 43% of shopping tests. Samsung sees memory shortage to 2028; Apple told suppliers 16M MacBook Neo for 2027.

points.headline: Amazon turns Alexa into a full shopping agent, now via text
points.detail: Alexa for Shopping gained 100+ functions, merchant registration and text-to-shop for select US users. We should check how our listings and feeds surface there.

points.headline: Agent checkout is scaling but still unreliable
points.detail: Walmart added visual recognition and cart generation to Sparky, while Visa found AI models fail 43% of shopping test runs. We should test how agents handle our store.

points.headline: Memory shortage keeps PC costs high while Apple plans volume push
points.detail: Samsung sees memory tightness lasting through 2028; Apple told suppliers to plan 16M MacBook Neo units in 2027. We should plan pricing and promos around component costs and entry-level competition.

points.headline: Marketplace costs rise as TikTok Shop builds a new channel
points.detail: Amazon seller fees and ads hit $66.1B in Q3, and TikTok launched a stand-alone Shop app. We should weigh Amazon margin against own-store growth and test TikTok for accessories.
